The start screen is pushed to GitHub, to the branch **`feat/pm-inbox`** on `github.com/Oleks0ir/kolosok-rehack`. (A branch is a separate line of commits, like a copy of the code you can change without touching `main`.)

It went up as two commits:
- `1649980`: the start screen redesign (M stripes flowing like a Sankey diagram)
- `02663dd`: the design rules, written down in `gui/DESIGN.md`

Your local branch matches GitHub for those commits, so both are on GitHub.

**Some newer work hasn't been pushed.** These files have changes that aren't committed yet: `gui/app.js`, `index.html`, `layout.js`, `start.css`, `style.css`, plus a new `gui/theme.css` (about 420 lines changed in total). `theme.css` was created at 09:02, a few minutes after the last session ended, so this is newer work that isn't on GitHub yet. It isn't in `main` either; the start screen is only on `feat/pm-inbox` until someone merges it.

Do you want me to commit and push those changes too? I'd look at them first to check what they are.
